object.attr: derived: a valid root that isn't the one meant (an agent's worktree, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR from another session), or another Mellon release, passes without a sign; the log has to show what was checked, at which commit, by which release (CF-C1, CF-C27, CF-C35).
object.description: mellon-check shall print as its first line its own version, the absolute path of the folder being checked and the full hash of the latest commit.
